description: The items of System knowledge, as the System knowledge page lists them for this user: for everyone the capabilities (what the agent can do for a user), entity groups and entities, each with its id, name, description and whether it is confirmed; a super admin sees every section with each item's statuses (intended, observed, reported, projected). Filter by section. Use get_knowledge for the summary and coverage.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

section.description: Only one section: capability, entity_group or entity for everyone; super admins also fact, component, state, action and transition.
section.title: Section

name: list_knowledge
